entries.label: NEUTRAL_SPACE_HELLO_1
entries.body: Greetings Fellow Carbon Creature, may your roots always be well watered.
entries.source: Greetings Fellow Carbon Creature, may your roots always be well watered.
entries.translation: 同為碳基生物的朋友， 向你問候，願你的根永遠獲 得充足水分。

entries.label: NEUTRAL_SPACE_HELLO_2
entries.body: Hello, Voyager. May the light always reach your leaves.
entries.source: Hello, Voyager. May the light always reach your leaves.
entries.translation: 你好，旅行者。 願光芒永遠照得到你的葉 片。

entries.label: NEUTRAL_HOMEWORLD_HELLO_1
entries.body: Greetings Fellow Carbon Creature, may your roots always be well watered.
entries.source: Greetings Fellow Carbon Creature, may your roots always be well watered.
entries.translation: 同為碳基生物的朋友， 向你問候，願你的根永遠獲 得充足水分。

entries.label: NEUTRAL_HOMEWORLD_HELLO_2
entries.body: Hello, Voyager. May the light always reach your leaves.
entries.source: Hello, Voyager. May the light always reach your leaves.
entries.translation: 你好，旅行者。 願光芒永遠照得到你的葉 片。

entries.label: HOSTILE_SPACE_HELLO_1
entries.body:
So it is you, the blockers of the warm green sunlight
the water poisoners
the heinous uprooters of flowering shrubbery.
Begone before our wrath overcomes our peaceful nature.
entries.source:
So it is you, the blockers of the warm green sunlight
the water poisoners
the heinous uprooters of flowering shrubbery.
Begone before our wrath overcomes our peaceful nature.
entries.translation:
原來就是你們， 遮擋溫暖綠色陽光的傢伙
毒害水源的傢伙
窮凶極惡、連開花灌木都連 根拔起的傢伙。
趁怒火尚未壓過我們和平的 天性，快滾。

entries.label: HOSTILE_SPACE_HELLO_2
entries.body:
You diandrous malefic vegetarians!
Your visage darkens our skies.
May your rotting bodies provide our nutrients for kinder generations.
We ignore you, as we ignore the pale, tasteless light of your wan home star.
entries.source:
You diandrous malefic vegetarians!
Your visage darkens our skies.
May your rotting bodies provide our nutrients for kinder generations.
We ignore you, as we ignore the pale, tasteless light of your wan home star.
entries.translation:
你們這些雙雄蕊的惡毒素食 者！
你們的醜臉遮暗了我們的天 空。
願你們腐爛的身軀， 為更仁慈的後世提供養分。
我們無視你們， 就如同無視你們那顆黯淡母 星發出的蒼白無味光芒。

entries.label: ALLIED_HOMEWORLD_HELLO_1
entries.body: Hail Fellow and Well Met. We trust that your seed distributes widely.
entries.source: Hail Fellow and Well Met. We trust that your seed distributes widely.
entries.translation: 朋友，幸會！願你的種子廣 為散播。

entries.label: ALLIED_HOMEWORLD_HELLO_2
entries.body: Be Welcome Friendly Allies. We hope that the Good Green Sunlight warms you.
entries.source: Be Welcome Friendly Allies. We hope that the Good Green Sunlight warms you.
entries.translation: 友善的盟友，歡迎你們。 願美好的綠色陽光溫暖你 們。

entries.label: ALLIED_HOMEWORLD_HELLO_3
entries.body: Greetings and Salutations. May fertilizer flow on your roots.
entries.source: Greetings and Salutations. May fertilizer flow on your roots.
entries.translation: 向你致意問候。 願肥料流向你的根部。

entries.label: ALLIED_HOMEWORLD_HELLO_4
entries.body: Hello there Good Folk. May your flowers always be pollinated.
entries.source: Hello there Good Folk. May your flowers always be pollinated.
entries.translation: 善良的朋友，你們好。 願你們的花朵永遠順利授 粉。

entries.label: i_am0
entries.body: I am Captain
entries.source: I am Captain
entries.translation: 我是艦長

entries.label: i_am1
entries.body: from Earth. We come in peace.
entries.source: from Earth. We come in peace.
entries.translation: ，來自地球。我們為和平而 來。

entries.label: WE_ARE_SUPOX
entries.body: I am Captain Ala-la'la. We come in peace.
entries.source: I am Captain Ala-la'la. We come in peace.
entries.translation: 我是 Ala-la'la 艦長。我們為和平而來。

entries.label: my_ship0
entries.body: Our starship is called
entries.source: Our starship is called
entries.translation: 我們的星艦叫做

entries.label: OUR_SHIP
entries.body: Our starship is called the Tender Shoot.
entries.source: Our starship is called the Tender Shoot.
entries.translation: 我們的星艦名叫嫩芽號。

entries.label: from_alliance0
entries.body: We are
entries.source: We are
entries.translation: 我們是

entries.label: from_alliance1
entries.body: From Earth.
entries.source: From Earth.
entries.translation: 來自地球。

entries.label: FROM_SUPOX
entries.body: We are the Supox Utricularia from Earth.
entries.source: We are the Supox Utricularia from Earth.
entries.translation: 我們是來自地球的蘇波克斯 狸藻。

entries.label: are_you_copying
entries.body: You're from Earth??? Hey! Are you just copying whatever I say?
entries.source: You're from Earth??? Hey! Are you just copying whatever I say?
entries.translation: 你們來自地球？？？嘿！ 你們只是在照抄我說的每句 話嗎？

entries.label: YEAH_SORRY
entries.body:
Oh yes, we apologize for the confusion, our homeworld is also called `Earth',
or more properly `Vlik', which means `Perfectly Good and Nutritious Dirt'.
`Earth' is pretty close, is it not?
entries.source:
Oh yes, we apologize for the confusion, our homeworld is also called `Earth',
or more properly `Vlik', which means `Perfectly Good and Nutritious Dirt'.
`Earth' is pretty close, is it not?
entries.translation:
喔，是的，造成混淆真的很 抱歉。我們的母星也叫做 「地球」
更正確的名稱則是「Vli k」，意思是「完美又營養 的好泥土」。
「地球」這個名稱也很接 近，不是嗎？

entries.label: why_copy
entries.body: Why do you copy our speech and mannerisms?
entries.source: Why do you copy our speech and mannerisms?
entries.translation: 你們為什麼要模仿我們的說 話方式與舉止？

entries.label: SYMBIOTS
entries.body:
We learn and we adapt. We are symbionts.
Our first step in making friends is always to copy them.
This is our idiom.
entries.source:
We learn and we adapt. We are symbionts.
Our first step in making friends is always to copy them.
This is our idiom.
entries.translation:
我們學習，也適應。 我們是共生生物。
我們結交朋友的第一步， 總是模仿對方。
這就是我們的表達方式。

entries.label: tell_us_of_your_species
entries.body: Symbionts, how interesting! Please tell us more.
entries.source: Symbionts, how interesting! Please tell us more.
entries.translation: 共生生物，真有意思！ 請再多告訴我們一些。

entries.label: OUR_SPECIES
entries.body:
Our kind evolved on a beautiful planet orbiting the wonderfully green-hued star, Root.
From the canopy of the great jungles to the shores of the azure seas
Our species has flowered and grown well.
Early in our evolution, we adapted to exist in symbiosis with other, hardier life, both flora and fauna,
who supplied us with nutrients while we supplied them with reproductive assistance.
entries.source:
Our kind evolved on a beautiful planet orbiting the wonderfully green-hued star, Root.
From the canopy of the great jungles to the shores of the azure seas
Our species has flowered and grown well.
Early in our evolution, we adapted to exist in symbiosis with other, hardier life, both flora and fauna,
who supplied us with nutrients while we supplied them with reproductive assistance.
entries.translation:
我們的族類在一顆美麗的行 星上演化，那顆行星環繞著 色澤翠綠迷人的 Root 星。
從廣大叢林的樹冠， 到蔚藍海洋的岸邊
我們的物種一路開花， 蓬勃成長。
演化初期，我們便適應了與 其他更強韌的生命共生， 包括動物與植物
他們提供我們養分， 而我們協助他們繁衍。

entries.label: plants_arent_intelligent
entries.body: C'mon, plants can't be intelligent! Our top scientists and science fiction writers have proven it!
entries.source: C'mon, plants can't be intelligent! Our top scientists and science fiction writers have proven it!
entries.translation: 拜託，植物不可能有智慧！ 我們最頂尖的科學家和科幻 作家早就證明了！

entries.label: PROVES_WERE_SPECIAL
entries.body:
Yes. This has been confirmed by our people as well. Strange, is it not?
Many of our people regard this inconsistency as proof of our divine origin.
entries.source:
Yes. This has been confirmed by our people as well. Strange, is it not?
Many of our people regard this inconsistency as proof of our divine origin.
entries.translation:
沒錯，我們的人民也證實了 這點。很奇怪，不是嗎？
許多族人認為， 這項矛盾正是我們具有神聖 起源的證明。

entries.label: anyone_around_here
entries.body: So this is your neighborhood, huh? Any other sentients nearby?
entries.source: So this is your neighborhood, huh? Any other sentients nearby?
entries.translation: 所以這一帶是你們的地盤 囉？附近還有其他智慧生物 嗎？

entries.label: UTWIG_NEARBY
entries.body:
We share this region of space with the Utwig, the Wearers of Masks.
We have a strong cultural bond with the Utwig.
They have been the foundation around which we have grown our starfaring culture.
We are not only allies, but we are also friends.
You should go meet with them. They could use some excitement.
You see, they are a little depressed and morose right now.
Usually they are most festive and fun.
entries.source:
We share this region of space with the Utwig, the Wearers of Masks.
We have a strong cultural bond with the Utwig.
They have been the foundation around which we have grown our starfaring culture.
We are not only allies, but we are also friends.
You should go meet with them. They could use some excitement.
You see, they are a little depressed and morose right now.
Usually they are most festive and fun.
entries.translation:
我們與戴面具的烏特維格共 享這片星域。
我們和烏特維格有深厚的文 化聯繫。
他們是我們發展星際航行文 化所依憑的根基。
我們不僅是盟友， 更是朋友。
你們應該去見見他們。 他們正需要一點振奮人心的 事。
因為，他們現在有些消沉而 憂鬱。
他們平常其實最愛慶典， 也很有趣。

entries.label: what_relation_to_utwig
entries.body: Are the Utwig friends of yours?
entries.source: Are the Utwig friends of yours?
entries.translation: 烏特維格是你們的朋友嗎？

entries.label: UTWIG_ALLIES
entries.body:
Oh yes, we have a strong cultural bond with the Utwig.
They have been the foundation around which we have grown our starfaring culture.
We are not only allies, but we are also friends.
You should go meet with them. They could use some excitement.
You see, they are a little depressed and morose right now.
Usually they are most festive and fun.

entries.translation:
喔，是的，我們和烏特維格 有深厚的文化聯繫。
他們是我們發展星際航行文 化所依憑的根基。
我們不僅是盟友， 更是朋友。
你們應該去見見他們。 他們正需要一點振奮人心的 事。
因為，他們現在有些消沉而 憂鬱。
他們平常其實最愛慶典， 也很有趣。

entries.label: whats_wrong_with_utwig
entries.body: Oh dear, what has caused the Utwig such distress?
entries.source: Oh dear, what has caused the Utwig such distress?
entries.translation: 天啊，是什麼事讓烏特維格 如此痛苦？

entries.label: BROKE_ULTRON
entries.body: They broke their Ultron.
entries.source: They broke their Ultron.
entries.translation: 他們把自己的烏爾創摔壞 了。

entries.label: whats_ultron
entries.body: Ultron? What's an Ultron?
entries.source: Ultron? What's an Ultron?
entries.translation: 烏爾創？烏爾創是什麼？

entries.label: TAKE_ULTRON
entries.body:
The Druuge, the cruel, sallow trading race who sold the device to the Utwig
called the device the `Ultron' and claimed that it would give the Utwig super-powers.
Unfortunately, the Utwig believed the Druuge and bought the Ultron.
However, the device DID make the Utwig very happy.
Of course, we didn't tell them what we REALLY thought of the Ultron
that they were vapid fools to buy a piece of junk for a planet's ransom.
We went along with the falsehood, and in doing so showed our own stupidity.
Then, one sad day a few years ago, the Utwig Proctor dropped the Ultron
during a particularly energetic and festive ritual.
Now the Utwig are morose and depressed.
They feel they cannot ever achieve greatness because they lost the powers of the Ultron.
They even gave the broken device to us, saying that they couldn't stand the sight of it anymore.
We are worried that the Utwig are so depressed that they may use their Ultimate Weapon.
Here! You take the Ultron, maybe you can do something with it.
entries.source:
The Druuge, the cruel, sallow trading race who sold the device to the Utwig
called the device the `Ultron' and claimed that it would give the Utwig super-powers.
Unfortunately, the Utwig believed the Druuge and bought the Ultron.
However, the device DID make the Utwig very happy.
Of course, we didn't tell them what we REALLY thought of the Ultron
that they were vapid fools to buy a piece of junk for a planet's ransom.
We went along with the falsehood, and in doing so showed our own stupidity.
Then, one sad day a few years ago, the Utwig Proctor dropped the Ultron
during a particularly energetic and festive ritual.
Now the Utwig are morose and depressed.
They feel they cannot ever achieve greatness because they lost the powers of the Ultron.
They even gave the broken device to us, saying that they couldn't stand the sight of it anymore.
We are worried that the Utwig are so depressed that they may use their Ultimate Weapon.
Here! You take the Ultron, maybe you can do something with it.
entries.translation:
德魯吉是個殘酷、 面色蠟黃的商業種族， 他們把裝置賣給烏特維格時
將它稱為「烏爾創」， 並宣稱它能賦予烏特維格超 能力。
不幸的是，烏特維格相信了 德魯吉，買下了烏爾創。
不過，這具裝置的確讓烏特 維格非常快樂。
我們當然沒告訴他們， 自己心裡對烏爾創的真正想 法
那就是他們竟拿一顆行星的 贖金去買一件破爛， 根本是群空洞的蠢蛋。
我們配合了那個謊言， 也因此展現了自己的愚蠢。
接著在幾年前某個悲傷的日 子，烏特維格監理官正進行 一場格外熱烈歡騰的儀式
卻失手摔落了烏爾創。
從此烏特維格就變得鬱鬱寡 歡、意志消沉。
他們覺得自己失去了烏爾創 的力量，再也無法成就偉 業。
他們甚至把壞掉的裝置交給 我們，說自己再也不忍看見 它。
我們擔心烏特維格會因過度 絕望而使用終極武器。
來！你把烏爾創拿去， 也許你能想想辦法。

entries.label: what_do_i_do_now
entries.body: Er, ah, thanks, I think. What do I do with it?
entries.source: Er, ah, thanks, I think. What do I do with it?
entries.translation: 呃，啊，我想……謝謝吧。 我要拿它怎麼辦？

entries.label: FIX_IT
entries.body:
We thought that if we could get the Ultron working again, it would cheer them up.
So we tried to figure out how to fix the darn thing
or at least get some of the flashing bits working again.
But for all the Druuge's falsehoods, the Ultron IS some kind of artifact
and we could not synthesize the necessary replacement parts.
Perhaps on your journeys you will find the elements necessary to repair the Ultron.
Then you could give it to the Utwig and maybe they wouldn't be so depressed.
entries.source:
We thought that if we could get the Ultron working again, it would cheer them up.
So we tried to figure out how to fix the darn thing
or at least get some of the flashing bits working again.
But for all the Druuge's falsehoods, the Ultron IS some kind of artifact
and we could not synthesize the necessary replacement parts.
Perhaps on your journeys you will find the elements necessary to repair the Ultron.
Then you could give it to the Utwig and maybe they wouldn't be so depressed.
entries.translation:
我們本來以為， 只要讓烏爾創重新運作， 就能使他們振作起來。
因此我們試著想辦法修好這 該死的東西
至少也想讓其中幾個閃爍的 零件重新亮起來。
但儘管德魯吉滿口謊言， 烏爾創的確是某種神器
我們無法合成它所需的替換 零件。
或許你能在旅途中找到修復 烏爾創所需的材料。
到時你就能把它交給烏特維 格，也許他們便不會如此消 沉。

entries.label: thanks_now_we_eat_you
entries.body: Why thanks. You know you remind me of Broccoli, and I'm rather partial to Broccoli with a light cheese sauce.
entries.source: Why thanks. You know you remind me of Broccoli, and I'm rather partial to Broccoli with a light cheese sauce.
entries.translation: 那就謝謝了。知道嗎， 你讓我想到綠花椰菜， 而我還挺喜歡淋上一點起司 醬的綠花椰菜。

entries.label: HIDEOUS_MONSTERS
entries.body:
Arrgh, you hideous monsters, vegetarians, defilers of the leaf, uprooters.
Begone, or we shall uproot you!
entries.source:
Arrgh, you hideous monsters, vegetarians, defilers of the leaf, uprooters.
Begone, or we shall uproot you!
entries.translation:
啊啊，你們這些醜惡的怪 物、素食者、玷汙葉片者、 拔根者。
快滾，否則我們就把你們連 根拔起！

entries.label: got_fixed_ultron
entries.body: This time we are sure we have repaired the Ultron completely.
entries.source: This time we are sure we have repaired the Ultron completely.
entries.translation: 這一次，我們確定已把烏爾 創完全修復了。

entries.label: GOOD_GIVE_TO_UTWIG
entries.body:
Oh Wonderful, Oh Rapturous Light of the Green Sun!
Please convey it immediately to the Utwig, they will be elated!
entries.source:
Oh Wonderful, Oh Rapturous Light of the Green Sun!
Please convey it immediately to the Utwig, they will be elated!
entries.translation:
喔，太美妙了，喔， 令人心醉神迷的綠色太陽之 光！
請立刻把它交給烏特維格， 他們一定會欣喜若狂！

entries.label: look_i_repaired_lots
entries.body: We hope we have repaired the Ultron completely.
entries.source: We hope we have repaired the Ultron completely.
entries.translation: 希望我們已把烏爾創完全修 復了。

entries.label: ALMOST_THERE
entries.body:
Yes! Yes!
But, but no... it is still not quite as brightly lit as it once was.
One more repair job should do it!
entries.source:
Yes! Yes!
But, but no... it is still not quite as brightly lit as it once was.
One more repair job should do it!
entries.translation:
沒錯！沒錯！
但是、但是不對…… 它還是沒有以前那麼明亮。
再修一次應該就行了！

entries.label: look_i_slightly_repaired
entries.body: We have fixed the Ultron.
entries.source: We have fixed the Ultron.
entries.translation: 我們修好了烏爾創。

entries.label: GREAT_DO_MORE
entries.body:
Great! Great!
Oh, dear
It is true that you have repaired the Ultron... somewhat
but it is not yet in the condition which so enthralled the Utwig.
Your efforts are valid, merely incomplete.
entries.source:
Great! Great!
Oh, dear
It is true that you have repaired the Ultron... somewhat
but it is not yet in the condition which so enthralled the Utwig.
Your efforts are valid, merely incomplete.
entries.translation:
太好了！太好了！
喔，天啊
你們的確修復了烏爾創…… 修了一部分
但它尚未恢復到當初令烏特 維格如此著迷的狀態。
你們的努力確有成效， 只是還沒完成。

entries.label: where_get_repairs
entries.body: Where do you think I can find repair materials for this `Ultron' thing?
entries.source: Where do you think I can find repair materials for this `Ultron' thing?
entries.translation: 你覺得我可以去哪裡找到修 理這個「烏爾創」的材料？

entries.label: ANCIENT_RHYME
entries.body:
Perhaps a good place to start would be the Druuge
since they were the ones who sold it to the Utwig in the first place.
entries.source:
Perhaps a good place to start would be the Druuge
since they were the ones who sold it to the Utwig in the first place.
entries.translation:
或許可以先去找德魯吉
畢竟最初就是他們把它賣給 烏特維格的。

entries.label: bye_neutral
entries.body: We're off now! See you later, Supox friends.
entries.source: We're off now! See you later, Supox friends.
entries.translation: 我們要出發了！回頭見， 蘇波克斯朋友。

entries.label: GOODBYE_NEUTRAL
entries.body: May Sunlight and Water always fall upon you.
entries.source: May Sunlight and Water always fall upon you.
entries.translation: 願陽光與水永遠降在你們身 上。

entries.label: ABOUT_BATTLE
entries.body:
Hello Captain.
We fought the Kohr-Ah; our buddies the Utwig did some pretty serious damage
to several fleets, but we mostly just watched helplessly.
The Ur-Quan did not seem to realize that we were helping them
and as often as not they attacked us too!
We may have delayed the outcome of the fight, but it still seems clear that the Kohr-Ah are winning.
entries.source:
Hello Captain.
We fought the Kohr-Ah; our buddies the Utwig did some pretty serious damage
to several fleets, but we mostly just watched helplessly.
The Ur-Quan did not seem to realize that we were helping them
and as often as not they attacked us too!
We may have delayed the outcome of the fight, but it still seems clear that the Kohr-Ah are winning.
entries.translation:
你好，艦長。
我們和克爾阿交戰了； 我們的烏特維格夥伴重創了
好幾支艦隊，但我們大多只 能無助地在一旁看著。
烏爾關似乎沒發現我們是在 幫助他們
甚至常常連我們也一起攻 擊！
我們或許延緩了戰鬥結果， 但克爾阿顯然仍會獲勝。

entries.label: HELLO_BEFORE_KOHRAH_SPACE_1
entries.body: Hello Fellow Warriors. We go to uproot our enemies!
entries.source: Hello Fellow Warriors. We go to uproot our enemies!
entries.translation: 各位戰友，你們好。 我們要去把敵人連根拔起！

entries.label: HELLO_BEFORE_KOHRAH_SPACE_2
entries.body: Greetings Garden Guardians. We shall block the Kohr-Ah's sunlight and frost their leaves!
entries.source: Greetings Garden Guardians. We shall block the Kohr-Ah's sunlight and frost their leaves!
entries.translation: 各位園圃守衛，你們好。 我們要遮斷克爾阿的陽光， 讓他們的葉片結霜！

entries.label: HELLO_DURING_KOHRAH_SPACE_1
entries.body:
Human! Your presence here is comforting, but perhaps you had better leave the area
our combat with the Kohr-Ah is fierce, and you could be destroyed.
entries.source:
Human! Your presence here is comforting, but perhaps you had better leave the area
our combat with the Kohr-Ah is fierce, and you could be destroyed.
entries.translation:
人類！你出現在此令我們安 心，但或許你最好離開這片 區域
我們與克爾阿戰況激烈， 你可能會遭到摧毀。

entries.label: HELLO_DURING_KOHRAH_SPACE_2
entries.body:
Greetings again, Captain. We hope you thrive.
We fight on bravely, but the course of events does not appear to be moving in our favor.
entries.source:
Greetings again, Captain. We hope you thrive.
We fight on bravely, but the course of events does not appear to be moving in our favor.
entries.translation:
再次問候，艦長。 願你茁壯。
我們英勇奮戰， 但局勢的發展似乎對我們不 利。

entries.label: HELLO_AFTER_KOHRAH_SPACE_1
entries.body: Ah, our human friend... we are so tired... the battle so difficult...
entries.source: Ah, our human friend... we are so tired... the battle so difficult...
entries.translation: 啊，我們的人類朋友…… 我們好累……這場仗好艱 難……

entries.label: HELLO_AFTER_KOHRAH_SPACE_2
entries.body: Hello again faunal comrade. We are spent, and must grow new bark.
entries.source: Hello again faunal comrade. We are spent, and must grow new bark.
entries.translation: 又見面了，動物夥伴。 我們筋疲力竭， 必須長出新的樹皮。

entries.label: whats_up_after_space
entries.body: Tell me more about the battle with the Kohr-Ah.
entries.source: Tell me more about the battle with the Kohr-Ah.
entries.translation: 再多告訴我一些與克爾阿交 戰的情形。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_AFTER_SPACE_1
entries.body:
We met the Kohr-Ah at the sides of our Utwig allies.
The destructive power of the black ships was greater than anticipated
however we did eventually develop tactics in conjunction with the Utwig
that were effective against them. We destroyed dozens of their battleships!
Alas, we lost many of our brothers to the spinning blades and the fiery ring.
entries.source:
We met the Kohr-Ah at the sides of our Utwig allies.
The destructive power of the black ships was greater than anticipated
however we did eventually develop tactics in conjunction with the Utwig
that were effective against them. We destroyed dozens of their battleships!
Alas, we lost many of our brothers to the spinning blades and the fiery ring.
entries.translation:
我們與烏特維格盟友並肩迎 戰克爾阿。
黑色船艦的破壞力比預期更 強
不過，我們後來確實與烏特 維格共同發展出
能有效對付他們的戰術。 我們摧毀了數十艘敵方戰 艦！
唉，許多同胞命喪旋轉刀刃 與烈焰之環。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_AFTER_SPACE_2
entries.body:
As dictated by the Utwig, our policy was to focus our weapons on the Kohr-Ah only.
In this way, we would reduce the strength of the black fleet, thus evening the balance of power
between the Ur-Quan and the Kohr-Ah. The plan worked well, save for one slight factor.
The green ships failed to notice our efforts on their behalf
and fired upon our vessels at every opportunity.
entries.source:
As dictated by the Utwig, our policy was to focus our weapons on the Kohr-Ah only.
In this way, we would reduce the strength of the black fleet, thus evening the balance of power
between the Ur-Quan and the Kohr-Ah. The plan worked well, save for one slight factor.
The green ships failed to notice our efforts on their behalf
and fired upon our vessels at every opportunity.
entries.translation:
按照烏特維格的指示， 我們的方針是只把武器對準 克爾阿。
如此便能削弱黑色艦隊的實 力，進而拉平
烏爾關與克爾阿之間的力量 差距。計畫進行得很順利， 只除了一個小問題。
綠色船艦沒有發現我們替他 們做出的努力
每逢有機會，都會向我們的 船艦開火。

entries.label: what_now_after_space
entries.body: What do you think we should do now?
entries.source: What do you think we should do now?
entries.translation: 你覺得我們現在該怎麼辦？

entries.label: DO_THIS_AFTER_SPACE
entries.body:
We are but humble plants, mere saplings in knowledge of such things.
If you seek wisdom, visit the Utwig Proctors.
entries.source:
We are but humble plants, mere saplings in knowledge of such things.
If you seek wisdom, visit the Utwig Proctors.
entries.translation:
我們只是卑微的植物， 對這類事物的知識不過是稚 嫩幼苗。
若你尋求智慧， 請拜訪烏特維格監理官。

entries.label: bye_after_space
entries.body: Goodbye Supox. Thanks for everything.
entries.source: Goodbye Supox. Thanks for everything.
entries.translation: 再見，蘇波克斯。 謝謝你們所做的一切。

entries.label: GOODBYE_AFTER_SPACE
entries.body: Fare thee well.
entries.source: Fare thee well.
entries.translation: 祝你一路平安。

entries.label: whats_up_before_space
entries.body: So what are you doing?
entries.source: So what are you doing?
entries.translation: 所以你們正在做什麼？

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_BEFORE_SPACE_1
entries.body:
Our Utwig allies have instructed us to prepare for combat, and so we make ready!
Our destination is Antares, where we shall face the Kohr-Ah in battle!
entries.source:
Our Utwig allies have instructed us to prepare for combat, and so we make ready!
Our destination is Antares, where we shall face the Kohr-Ah in battle!
entries.translation:
烏特維格盟友已指示我們準 備作戰，因此我們正在整 備！
我們的目的地是 Antares， 將在那裡與克爾阿決一死 戰！

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_BEFORE_SPACE_2
entries.body: We make our way to an epic confrontation with the Kohr-Ah!
entries.source: We make our way to an epic confrontation with the Kohr-Ah!
entries.translation: 我們正前往與克爾阿展開一 場史詩級對決！

entries.label: what_now_before_space
entries.body: So what should we do now?
entries.source: So what should we do now?
entries.translation: 所以我們現在該怎麼辦？

entries.label: DO_THIS_BEFORE_SPACE
entries.body:
We must defer to the Utwig, who have superior knowledge of such things.
They specifically instructed us to inform you
that you should NOT endanger yourself by joining us in this battle.
Your destiny lies along a more subtle though crucial course.
entries.source:
We must defer to the Utwig, who have superior knowledge of such things.
They specifically instructed us to inform you
that you should NOT endanger yourself by joining us in this battle.
Your destiny lies along a more subtle though crucial course.
entries.translation:
我們必須聽從烏特維格， 因為他們更了解這類事情。
他們特別囑咐我們通知你
你不該加入這場戰鬥， 讓自己身陷險境。
你的命運在一條更為隱晦、 卻至關重要的道路上。

entries.label: bye_before_space
entries.body: G'bye plant dudes.
entries.source: G'bye plant dudes.
entries.translation: 掰啦，植物老兄們。

entries.label: GOODBYE_BEFORE_SPACE
entries.body: Wish us luck, human.
entries.source: Wish us luck, human.
entries.translation: 人類，祝我們好運吧。

entries.label: how_went_war
entries.body: What happened at Antares? Describe the struggle.
entries.source: What happened at Antares? Describe the struggle.
entries.translation: Antares 發生了什麼事？ 描述一下那場戰鬥。

entries.label: how_goes_war
entries.body: How fares the battle against the Kohr-Ah?
entries.source: How fares the battle against the Kohr-Ah?
entries.translation: 對抗克爾阿的戰況如何？

entries.label: BATTLE_HAPPENS_1
entries.body:
Fearsome, human, fearsome! We have not yet evolved tactics
which are useful against the Kohr-Ah Marauder vessels.
The dark ships launch spinning wheels of metal... we are mown down like
I don't even want to say it... and if we are fortunate enough to close with the ships
ports open up around its perimeter, jetting forth gouts of flaming plasma.
Not only do these flames melt through our hulls like a scythe
but they are also an effective defense against our glob weapon.
entries.source:
Fearsome, human, fearsome! We have not yet evolved tactics
which are useful against the Kohr-Ah Marauder vessels.
The dark ships launch spinning wheels of metal... we are mown down like
I don't even want to say it... and if we are fortunate enough to close with the ships
ports open up around its perimeter, jetting forth gouts of flaming plasma.
Not only do these flames melt through our hulls like a scythe
but they are also an effective defense against our glob weapon.
entries.translation:
可怕，人類，太可怕了！ 我們尚未演化出
能有效對付克爾阿掠奪艦的 戰術。
黑暗船艦會發射旋轉的金屬 輪……我們被割倒，就像
我連說都不想說…… 就算我們有幸接近那些船艦
它們周圍也會開啟發射口， 噴出股股燃燒的電漿。
那些火焰不只像鐮刀一樣熔 穿我們的船殼
還能有效抵禦我們的黏液球 武器。

entries.label: BATTLE_HAPPENS_2
entries.body:
We are having greater success, human, praise the light!
We have learned that we must work in tandem with our Utwig allies
letting them absorb the brunt of the Kohr-Ah firepower on their shields
while we play the role of opportunist, striking only when the Kohr-Ah is de-energized
and then retreating to permit our Utwig allies to renew the cycle.
entries.source:
We are having greater success, human, praise the light!
We have learned that we must work in tandem with our Utwig allies
letting them absorb the brunt of the Kohr-Ah firepower on their shields
while we play the role of opportunist, striking only when the Kohr-Ah is de-energized
and then retreating to permit our Utwig allies to renew the cycle.
entries.translation:
我們愈來愈順利了，人類， 讚美光明！
我們已學會必須與烏特維格 盟友協同作戰
讓他們以護盾承受克爾阿的 大部分火力
而我們則扮演伺機而動的角 色，只在克爾阿能量耗盡時 出擊
接著撤退，讓烏特維格盟友 再次開始這套循環。

entries.label: FLEET_ON_WAY
entries.body:
Even as we speak, the Utwig and Supox fleets streak toward Horologii
where they hope to strike a major blow against the Kohr-Ah forces.
entries.source:
Even as we speak, the Utwig and Supox fleets streak toward Horologii
where they hope to strike a major blow against the Kohr-Ah forces.
entries.translation:
就在我們交談的此刻， 烏特維格與蘇波克斯艦隊正 疾馳前往 Horologii
希望在那裡對克爾阿部隊造 成重大打擊。

entries.label: learn_new_info
entries.body: Have your fighting forces learned anything I should know?
entries.source: Have your fighting forces learned anything I should know?
entries.translation: 你們的作戰部隊有沒有得到 什麼我該知道的情報？

entries.label: NO_NEW_INFO
entries.body:
No, not as yet. Although the region of space they are fighting in is new to us
our vessels are not engaging in any form of research
reducing the Kohr-Ah's strength is their prime directive.
entries.source:
No, not as yet. Although the region of space they are fighting in is new to us
our vessels are not engaging in any form of research
reducing the Kohr-Ah's strength is their prime directive.
entries.translation:
目前還沒有。雖然他們作戰 的星域對我們而言相當陌生
但我方船艦並未從事任何形 式的研究
削弱克爾阿實力才是他們的 首要指令。

entries.label: SAMATRA
entries.body:
During the battle, one of our ships intercepted a signal
from an Ur-Quan vessel to a Kohr-Ah ship.
The contents of the message was simple, `Sa-Matra'.
Immediately after receiving the broadcast, the Kohr-Ah vessel disengaged from combat
entered HyperSpace and sped off in the direction of the Crateris stars.
entries.source:
During the battle, one of our ships intercepted a signal
from an Ur-Quan vessel to a Kohr-Ah ship.
The contents of the message was simple, `Sa-Matra'.
Immediately after receiving the broadcast, the Kohr-Ah vessel disengaged from combat
entered HyperSpace and sped off in the direction of the Crateris stars.
entries.translation:
戰鬥期間，我方有一艘船攔 截到一道訊號
是由一艘烏爾關船艦傳給一 艘克爾阿船艦的。
訊息內容很簡單： 「薩馬特拉」。
收到廣播後，克爾阿船艦立 刻脫離戰鬥
進入超空間，朝 Crateris 群星的方向飛馳而去。

entries.label: what_now_homeworld
entries.body: So now what do we do?
entries.source: So now what do we do?
entries.translation: 那麼我們現在該怎麼辦？

entries.label: HOPE_KILL_EACH_OTHER
entries.body:
We can only hope that the opposing forces of the Ur-Quan and Kohr-Ah
are sufficiently even in power, that they reduce each other to insignificance.
entries.source:
We can only hope that the opposing forces of the Ur-Quan and Kohr-Ah
are sufficiently even in power, that they reduce each other to insignificance.
entries.translation:
我們只能寄望烏爾關與克爾 阿這兩股敵對勢力
實力相差無幾， 最終彼此削弱到微不足道。

entries.label: UP_TO_YOU
entries.body:
Our hopes that the Ur-Quan and Kohr-Ah would destroy each other have been in vain.
Once victorious, the Kohr-Ah will proceed on their grim cruise of destruction.
I believe you and your people are our only hope now.
You must find some way to stop the Kohr-Ah.
entries.source:
Our hopes that the Ur-Quan and Kohr-Ah would destroy each other have been in vain.
Once victorious, the Kohr-Ah will proceed on their grim cruise of destruction.
I believe you and your people are our only hope now.
You must find some way to stop the Kohr-Ah.
entries.translation:
我們原本希望烏爾關與克爾 阿互相毀滅，看來已經落 空。
克爾阿獲勝之後， 就會繼續踏上那趟冷酷的毀 滅巡航。
我相信你與你的人民現在是 我們唯一的希望。
你必須想辦法阻止克爾阿。

entries.label: can_you_help
entries.body: Two leaves pull water from the same root.
entries.source: Two leaves pull water from the same root.
entries.translation: 兩片葉子從同一條根汲取水 分。

entries.label: HOW_HELP
entries.body:
Such wisdom! Your meanings run deep, we ponder their significance.
Ah, yes! You wish us to give you assistance... such as our fighting ships!
entries.source:
Such wisdom! Your meanings run deep, we ponder their significance.
Ah, yes! You wish us to give you assistance... such as our fighting ships!
entries.translation:
多麼有智慧！你的話含意深 遠，我們正在思索其中意 義。
啊，懂了！你想請我們提供 援助……例如我們的作戰船 艦！

entries.label: DONT_NEED
entries.body:
Yet, you seem to possess a fleet in concert with your need.
We will reserve what few ships we have left for our final defense against the Kohr-Ah.
entries.source:
Yet, you seem to possess a fleet in concert with your need.
We will reserve what few ships we have left for our final defense against the Kohr-Ah.
entries.translation:
不過，你擁有的艦隊似乎已 足以配合你的需求。
我們會保留僅存的少數船 艦，用於對抗克爾阿的最後 防衛。

entries.label: HAVE_4_SHIPS
entries.body: Your words have merit. We shall dispatch a pod of our starships to join your fleet.
entries.source: Your words have merit. We shall dispatch a pod of our starships to join your fleet.
entries.translation: 你的話很有道理。 我們會派出一群星艦加入你 的艦隊。

entries.label: give_info
entries.body: Is there any knowledge which you alone possess?
entries.source: Is there any knowledge which you alone possess?
entries.translation: 有沒有什麼知識是只有你們 才知道的？

entries.label: GOOD_HINTS
entries.body:
Knowledge is the purview of the Utwig. We Supox are but the effectuators.
In truth though, we have learned a fact or two unknown to others.
We did not think anyone would care in the slightest, but since you ask, listen.
We have not fared far from our region of space, but we have explored this region thoroughly.
Of all the oddities we have found, from the firefalls of Nalnar to the servants of Mali
the truest mystery was the nature of a world we found at the orange star, Beta Leporis.
As a general rule, we prefer not to dwell in such long-wavelength regions
but we were on a mapping mission. That was when we found the planet.
At first we thought our scanners had failed, for they showed us a world of chromatic aspect.
Then we located the source of our malfunction... the planet itself!
Somehow the planet generates a field of unusual radiations which scramble delicate circuitry.
Though blazing hot, we attempted a landing. Before we were forced off the surface by the intense heat
we registered the presence of huge amounts of processed radioactives.
Strange, is it not?
entries.source:
Knowledge is the purview of the Utwig. We Supox are but the effectuators.
In truth though, we have learned a fact or two unknown to others.
We did not think anyone would care in the slightest, but since you ask, listen.
We have not fared far from our region of space, but we have explored this region thoroughly.
Of all the oddities we have found, from the firefalls of Nalnar to the servants of Mali
the truest mystery was the nature of a world we found at the orange star, Beta Leporis.
As a general rule, we prefer not to dwell in such long-wavelength regions
but we were on a mapping mission. That was when we found the planet.
At first we thought our scanners had failed, for they showed us a world of chromatic aspect.
Then we located the source of our malfunction... the planet itself!
Somehow the planet generates a field of unusual radiations which scramble delicate circuitry.
Though blazing hot, we attempted a landing. Before we were forced off the surface by the intense heat
we registered the presence of huge amounts of processed radioactives.
Strange, is it not?
entries.translation:
知識是烏特維格的專長。 我們蘇波克斯只負責執行。
不過說真的，我們確實得知 了一兩件其他人不知道的 事。
我們本以為沒有人會有絲毫 興趣，但既然你問了， 就請聽好。
我們不曾遠離自己的星域， 但已徹底探索過這片區域。
在我們發現的所有奇觀中， 從 Nalnar 的火瀑到 Mali 的僕從
最不可思議的謎團， 是我們在橙色恆星 Beta Leporis 發現的一顆星球。
一般來說，我們不喜歡停留 在這類長波長區域
不過當時正在執行測繪任 務。我們就是在那時發現了 那顆行星。
起初，我們以為掃描器出了 故障，因為畫面顯示出一顆 色彩斑斕的世界。
接著我們找到了故障的來 源……正是那顆行星本身！
不知為何，那顆行星會產生 一種異常輻射場， 干擾精密電路。
儘管地表熱得灼人， 我們仍嘗試著陸。 在酷熱迫使我們離開地表以 前
我們偵測到大量經過加工的 放射性物質。
很奇怪，不是嗎？

entries.label: how_is_ultron
entries.body: So how are the Utwig liking their Ultron?
entries.source: So how are the Utwig liking their Ultron?
entries.translation: 所以烏特維格現在喜不喜歡 他們的烏爾創？

entries.label: ULTRON_IS_GREAT
entries.body:
They are beyond ecstatic, well into the range of rapture or perhaps even pegged on epiphany.
If you wish to learn the true depth of their joy, talk with them yourself.
entries.source:
They are beyond ecstatic, well into the range of rapture or perhaps even pegged on epiphany.
If you wish to learn the true depth of their joy, talk with them yourself.
entries.translation:
他們已不只是欣喜若狂， 而是進入狂喜境界， 甚至可能達到了頓悟的極 限。
如果你想知道他們的喜悅究 竟有多深，就親自去和他們 談談。

entries.label: bye_allied_homeworld
entries.body: Goodbye Leafy Ones.
entries.source: Goodbye Leafy Ones.
entries.translation: 再見了，多葉的朋友。

entries.label: GOODBYE_ALLIED_HOMEWORLD
entries.body: Farewell Friendly Folk.
entries.source: Farewell Friendly Folk.
entries.translation: 再會了，友善的朋友。

entries.label: name_1
entries.body: The New Alliance of Free Stars
entries.source: The New Alliance of Free Stars
entries.translation: 新自由星辰聯盟

entries.label: name_2
entries.body: The Concordance of Alien Nations
entries.source: The Concordance of Alien Nations
entries.translation: 外星國族協約

entries.label: name_3
entries.body: The United Federation of Worlds
entries.source: The United Federation of Worlds
entries.translation: 世界聯合聯邦

entries.label: name_40
entries.body: The Empire of
entries.source: The Empire of
entries.translation: 偉大的

entries.label: OUT_TAKES
entries.body:
Whew! I'm glad that's all over.
That was tough, playing second banana to the Utwig.
Now I'm hungry, but I'm sick and tired of sunlight, sunlight, sunlight!
I want some REAL food!!!
Like a hamburger or a steak... better yet
how about a dog!
entries.source:
Whew! I'm glad that's all over.
That was tough, playing second banana to the Utwig.
Now I'm hungry, but I'm sick and tired of sunlight, sunlight, sunlight!
I want some REAL food!!!
Like a hamburger or a steak... better yet
how about a dog!
entries.translation:
呼！總算全都結束了。
替烏特維格當配角還真累 人。
現在我餓了，但早已受夠陽 光、陽光、還是陽光！
我要來點真正的食物！！！
像是漢堡或牛排…… 更棒的是
來隻狗怎麼樣！
